Hi team,

Heads-up — Greencore just signed up and requested a 60-minute product demo. Prospect filled in that they want IT/security present for the call (SSO discussion + network requirements). Details below and attached the signup summary.

Prospect: Sam Jones, Head of Product — sam.jones@greencore.io
Company: Greencore Logistics (EMEA HQ in London, IT org in India)
Requested duration: 60 min
Preferred window (customer-provided): mornings BST, they noted "IT can join if it's after 4pm IST"
Signup source: self-serve trial -> Calendly link attached

Next suggested steps (from SDR):
- Tessa: can you own the AE intro/demo?
- Marcus: SE to join the demo and schedule a short tech pre-call with Priya (IT) if possible
- Ask customer to confirm one IT contact and any compliance docs they want ahead of time (SOC2/network list)

Attachment: signup-summary.json (includes time zone and Calendly payload)

Thanks — I left the Calendly invite open for them to pick, but they flagged that IT availability is the blocker.

—Monica

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>

Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: New inbound: Greencore (self-serve signup) — demo coordination

Hi Sam — great to meet you over email, thanks for signing up. I'm Tessa (AE) at Redwood — I'd love to run a tailored 60-minute session that covers the platform end-to-end and leaves time for customer questions. Marcus (CC) will join from SE to handle the technical depth.

Quick ask to help us pin a time: could you confirm an IT contact (name + email) who would join for the SSO/network portion? Monica mentioned your note about "IT can join if it's after 4pm IST" — that helps a lot. If it makes scheduling easier, we can split into: 30-min tech pre-call with IT + 45-min product demo for stakeholders.

A few candidate windows (please tell us what works in your local time):
- Tue 2026-09-24 09:00 BST (Tue 2026-09-24 13:30 IST / Tue 2026-09-24 01:00 PDT) — early for us but doable
- Tue 2026-09-24 12:30 BST (Tue 2026-09-24 17:00 IST / Tue 2026-09-24 04:30 PDT) — aligns with IT late afternoon
- Wed 2026-09-25 10:00 BST (Wed 2026-09-25 14:30 IST / Wed 2026-09-25 02:00 PDT)

If none of those work, let me know a couple of slots that fit your stakeholders + Priya and we'll adjust. Also, if there are specific compliance docs you'd like ahead of time (SOC2, retention, encryption) tell us and we'll include them.

Proposed agenda (can be split):
- 10 min intros / success criteria
- 30–40 min product demo (routing, latency/cost controls, rollout patterns)
- 10–15 min technical deep dive (KV cache, quantization, network needs)
- 5–10 min next steps (POC, Dedicated sizing)

Thanks — I'll hold the window on our side once you confirm. Zoom link and calendar invite to follow.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Sam Jones <sam.jones@greencore.io>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Verma <priya.verma@greencore.io>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Sep 2026 09:47:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: New inbound: Greencore (self-serve signup) — demo coordination

Thanks Tessa — appreciate the quick follow-up.

Priya Verma (IT lead) will join but she's only available after 16:30 IST on most days this week (she's hands-on with infra until late afternoons). Her email is priya.verma@greencore.io. Our core product team prefers mornings BST (09:00–11:00).

Given that constraint, the second slot you suggested (Tue 12:30 BST / 17:00 IST) looks promising for a combined session. If that is still early for your side, we're open to splitting: a short 30-min tech pre-call with Priya later in her afternoon + a stakeholder demo earlier in BST without Priya.

Also, can you share a short doc that outlines port/IP requirements and whether Redwood supports IdP-initiated SSO? Our security team will want to look before the call.

—Sam
Sam Jones | Head of Product, Greencore Logistics

Hi Sam / Priya — Marcus from Redwood SE here. Thanks for the availability note. I agree splitting makes the most sense so your product team doesn't have to block later in the day. Suggested plan:

1) Product demo (45 min) — Tue 2026-09-24 12:30 BST / Tue 2026-09-24 17:00 IST — high-level for product/ops
2) Tech pre-call (30 min) — Tue 2026-09-24 17:45 IST / Tue 2026-09-24 13:15 BST — focused on SSO, firewall/ports, and any network allowlists

I've attached a short network_ports.csv and our security-one-pager.pdf that covers SOC2 and data residency. For the pre-call we'll need firewall outbound to a small set of IP ranges (listed in the CSV) and a working IdP metadata endpoint if you want to test SSO during the call.

Drive folder with more tech notes: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1GreeNc0re-Tech-Prep

If those windows work, Tessa can send final invites (Zoom + ICS). If you prefer a different time for the 30-min pre-call, let us know a specific slot and we will move.

—Marcus
